backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the Hindu devotional app, defining data types (Festival, Mantra, Aarti, Shloka, Temple, CommunityPost, Katha, etc.) and initializing state maps for user profiles, temples, community posts, jap counters, dharma quotes, and kathayen with seeded Ramayan and Mahabharat entries.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report confirming that the static fallback katha data in frontend/src/lib/kathaData.ts was updated to include Ramayan and Mahabharat entries (Ramayan first) matching the backend structure for the Kathayen page.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend source files, describing the purpose and key details of each component, page, hook, and config file in the React frontend.
frontend/.env.example: Documents that no API key configuration is needed since the AI key is hardcoded in aiEngine.ts using Groq's free-tier API; VITE_GEMINI_API_KEY is no longer used.
frontend/index.css: Root CSS file importing Tailwind directives and defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark color themes including background, foreground, primary, chart, and sidebar tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Vite/React app, mounting the React root div and loading the main.tsx module script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that configures TanStack Router with all application routes (Home, Panchang, Jap, Mandir, Profile, Community, AartiDetail, AdminPanel, AIGuru, Kathayen, KathaDetail) wrapped in ThemeProvider and Toaster.
frontend/src/components/AartiCard.tsx: Reusable card component that renders a linked aarti item with an emoji icon, colored background, and name, navigating to the aarti detail route on click.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Shared app shell providing a sticky devotional header with Om logo and login button, main content outlet, bottom navigation, profile setup modal for new authenticated users, and a footer with Caffeine attribution.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Fixed bottom navigation bar with seven nav items (Home, Panchang, Jap, Kathayen, Mandir, AI Guru, Profile) that highlights the active route with gold styling.
frontend/src/components/ChatMessage.tsx: Chat bubble component rendering user or AI messages with avatar, timestamp, and simple markdown-like bold/newline formatting.
frontend/src/components/ChatTypingIndica: Renders an animated typing indicator bubble with an AI guru avatar and three bouncing saffron dots to show the AI is composing a response.
frontend/src/components/DailyDharmaQuote: Fetches and displays a daily dharma quote in Hindi and English with a fallback quote, showing a skeleton loader while data is loading.
frontend/src/components/FestivalCountdow: Displays the next upcoming Hindu festival with a days-remaining countdown and a button to download a generated festival countdown image card.
frontend/src/components/FloatingLotus.ts: Renders six floating lotus petal images as a fixed decorative background layer with staggered CSS float animations.
frontend/src/components/GoldenHalo.tsx: A wrapper component that renders a pulsing radial golden glow halo around its children, with configurable size presets.
frontend/src/components/KathaCard.tsx: Displays a linked card for a Katha (story) entry showing its category badge, deity, title, and a truncated Hindi text preview.
frontend/src/components/Loader.tsx: A loading spinner component that displays a spinning mandala image with an Om symbol overlay and an optional text label.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: A login/logout button using Internet Identity authentication that handles login state, clears the query cache on logout, and shows appropriate icons.
frontend/src/components/LotusBloomOverla: A full-screen animated overlay triggered on completing 108 japa repetitions, showing a lotus bloom image, petal burst particles, and a celebratory message.
frontend/src/components/MalaRing.tsx: Renders an animated canvas-based mala (prayer bead ring) with 108 beads that fill progressively based on the count prop, with a slow rotation and central Om symbol.
A short-lived particle effect component that animates three Om symbols bursting outward in different directions, auto-hiding after 700ms.
frontend/src/components/PremiumBanner.ts: Displays a dismissible premium upgrade banner with benefits list and a call-to-action button; dismissal state is persisted in sessionStorage.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog that prompts new users to enter their name and saves a UserProfile (with a default mantra) via the useSetUserProfile mutation.
frontend/src/components/SacredRipple.tsx: Renders animated concentric ripple rings centered on its container whenever the numeric trigger prop changes, keeping at most 4 simultaneous ripples.
frontend/src/components/ShlokaCard.tsx: Displays a Sanskrit shloka with Hindi/English meanings and provides copy, share, and canvas-based image-download actions.
frontend/src/components/VratModeDashboar: Dashboard for fasting/vrat tracking showing Brahma Muhurat time, a daily fasting check-in button, and countdown timers to upcoming Hindu festivals like Ekadashi and Shivratri.
frontend/src/components/VratModeToggle.t: Simple toggle switch component that enables or disables Vrat Mode, visually highlighting its active state with saffron styling.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, reinitializing and invalidating dependent queries whenever the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAIChat.ts: Custom hook managing AI chat state including message history, loading state, input value, and send/clear actions by calling getAIResponse with the last 6 messages as context.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login/logout functions and status flags. Includes an `InternetIdentityProvider` component that persists identity across page reloads.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend actor interactions including user profiles, jap counter, dharma quotes, festivals, and kathas. Uses `useActor` to access the canister actor and exposes both query and mutation hooks.
frontend/src/hooks/useSpeechNarration.ts: Custom hook wrapping the Web Speech API to play, pause, resume, and stop text-to-speech narration with Hindi (hi-IN) as the default language. Handles voice selection, fallback on unavailable voices, and cleanup on unmount.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet importing Google Fonts and Tailwind CSS, defining CSS custom properties for a devotional light/dark color theme (saffron, gold, maroon). Also declares keyframe animations for lotus floating, diya flickering, golden halo, and mandala spinning effects.
frontend/src/lib/aiEngine.ts: Implements a local spiritual AI response engine with predefined Hindi responses categorized by topics (meditation, mantra, dharma, Krishna, Shiva, yoga). Optionally enhances responses via the Groq API, falling back to local responses when unavailable.
frontend/src/lib/aiGuruData.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces and static data for a Hindu astrology AI guru feature, including all 12 zodiac signs (rashis) with metadata and Hindi prediction templates for love, career, and other life aspects.
frontend/src/lib/kathaData.ts: Contains static Hindi religious story (katha) data including full texts of Ramayan and other Puranic tales, typed with the Katha interface from the backend module.
frontend/src/lib/panchangEngine.ts: Implements accurate Hindu calendar (Panchang) calculations using Jean Meeus astronomical algorithms, computing sun/moon positions, Julian Day Numbers, and related values for IST and central India coordinates.
frontend/src/lib/staticData.ts: Provides static data for Hindu devotional content including Sanskrit shlokas with Hindi/English meanings and full aarti texts (Ganesh, Shiv, Vishnu, etc.) in both Hindi and transliterated English.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React application entry point that mounts the app with QueryClientProvider for data fetching and InternetIdentityProvider for ICP authentication.
frontend/src/pages/AartiDetail.tsx: Displays a detailed view of a single aarti fetched from static data, with Hindi/English toggle, copy-to-clipboard, and native share functionality.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin-only panel for managing user approvals, assigning roles, and adding dharma quotes, gated behind Internet Identity authentication and admin role checks.
frontend/src/pages/AIGuru.tsx: React page component for an AI spiritual guru chat interface, featuring a message list, auto-resizing textarea input, suggested questions, scroll-to-bottom button, and a clear chat option.
frontend/src/pages/Community.tsx: Community feed page showing seed posts with like/report actions, a compose dialog for new posts, and an approval-request flow for authenticated users.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Authenticated user dashboard that redirects unauthenticated users to home, shows a welcome message with profile data, and triggers a profile setup modal when no profile exists.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Main home page displaying a hero section with a greeting, today's panchang data, a dharma quote, featured aartis, and upcoming festivals with decorative animations.
frontend/src/pages/Jap.tsx: Jap (mantra chanting) counter page with a 108-bead mala ring, multi-mantra selector, local-storage persistence for guest users, and batched backend sync for authenticated users.
frontend/src/pages/KathaDetail.tsx: Detail page for a single Katha (sacred story) that displays Hindi/English text with language toggle, and supports text-to-speech narration using the Web Speech API. Falls back to static data if the backend returns nothing.
frontend/src/pages/Kathayen.tsx: Listing page for all Kathas with search, category tabs (All/Puranik/Vrat), and skeleton loading; falls back to static data if the backend returns no results.
frontend/src/pages/Mandir.tsx: Temple finder page that links to a Google Maps search for nearby Hindu temples and displays a static list of famous Indian temples with live darshan and directions buttons.
frontend/src/pages/Panchang.tsx: Hindu calendar (Panchang) page showing daily tithi, nakshatra, sunrise/sunset, and auspicious timings for a user-selected date, plus upcoming festivals fetched from the backend.
frontend/src/pages/Profile.tsx: User profile page allowing mantra selection (persisted to backend or localStorage), vrat mode toggle, jap stats display, and Internet Identity login/logout.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with helpers to persist, retrieve, and clear those values via sessionStorage and history.replaceState.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with a devotional color palette (saffron, gold, maroon, cream), custom fonts (Yatra One, Poppins), border radii, box shadows, and background images.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file recording existing features, pending feature requests (adding Ramayan and Mahabharat katha entries to both frontend fallback data and backend store), and project metadata for the 'Nam Jap' app.
